text: In July 2023 we spoke most often about the "national defense authorization act ndaa," 49 of us saying it on 2023-07-14, first said on 2013-01-03 by M001166. On the same peak day, 46 of us said "the national defense" and 45 said "the national defense authorization act," each first said 2013-01-03 by Michael F. Bennet. 35 of us said "our national security" that day. 31 of us said "the national defense authorization act ndaa." Six days later, on 2023-07-20, our attention moved to aviation: 35 of us said "aviation administration faa," first said 2013-01-28 by John Hoeven, and 28 of us said both "and robust leadership in american aviation" and "growth and robust leadership in american," each first said 2023-06-09 by Rick Larsen. This is what we repeated, and how many of us repeated it.
